review_type: Firmware buffer lifetime hardening and proc concurrency closure

branch_context.scope_note: All changes in this report are intentional hardening deviations on the hardening branch. Historical stock-exact attestations remain the baseline for the untouched reconstruction branch.

shared_state.lock_order: tp_firmware_data_mutex before cdev+0xc60; no path in the reviewed active call graph acquires these in reverse order
shared_state.scope: The outer mutex serializes complete self-test proc operations and each other active high-level buffer operation. The existing command mutex protects every slot dereference, replacement, memcpy, position update, and free. The command mutex is not held across the self-test callback.

stock_evidence.tpfwupgrade_reachability: zte_touch_probe.c:285 registers FW_upgrade with mode 0664; globals.c:2056 binds proc_write to tpfwupgrade_store.

target_kernel.proc_dispatch: The target proc_reg_read/proc_reg_write paths directly dispatch to proc_ops. Driver-side serialization was therefore added; no implicit proc callback lock is assumed.

changes_and_findings.details: A global tp_firmware_data_mutex now covers the complete tp_self_test_read and tp_self_test_write callbacks, so their read/write/free lifecycles cannot overlap. The read cleanup takes cmd_mutex before touching cdev+0xc58 and cdev+0x448. The write epilogue takes cmd_mutex and checks for a null descriptor before updating its size. Allocation and copy helpers take cmd_mutex around descriptor use and memory access.

The fwimage sysfs show/store callbacks, get_noise proc show/store callbacks, and FW_upgrade proc write callback acquire tp_firmware_data_mutex before cmd_mutex. The fwimage handlers now validate the slot only after acquiring both locks. The outer lock is not held as cmd_mutex, so self-test command callbacks can still use the command mutex internally.

On vmalloc failure, tp_alloc_tp_firmware_data clears cdev+0xc58 before freeing the descriptor. This closes the previously confirmed retry path through tp_self_test_write. Descriptor replacement is protected by cmd_mutex.

Ghidra stock pseudocode showed that tpfwupgrade_store freed the descriptor on vmalloc failure but left cdev+0xc58 unchanged. A later authorized write to the registered 0664 FW_upgrade proc entry could free the stale pointer again. The hardening branch clears the slot before kfree, under both locks.

first_failed_build.cause: One old tp_self_test_io_mutex reference remained in the read allocation-failure branch after the symbol rename.
first_failed_build.resolution: Corrected the relocation, reran source synchronization, and produced the passing two-cycle build above.

limitations: No NX809J hardware runtime test, forced allocator failure, concurrency stress test, KASAN or UBSAN run was performed.
The lock-order review is static; callback behavior on device hardware remains deferred.
tp_free_tp_firmware_data and tpd_reset_fw_data_pos_and_size have no incoming direct caller in the preserved Ghidra call inventory; their runtime reachability remains outside this batch.
Independent human review was not performed.
